bias.en: Rebound fading · holding $338, MACD near a cross
bias.zh: 反弹乏力 · 守住 $338，MACD 接近交叉

read.en: Applied Materials rose 0.9% on Nov 18 to $352.30, trading $342.32–356.00 on light volume (0.56x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($360.7, rising), 10-day ($359.3), 30-day ($399.2), 100-day ($478.6) and 200-day ($447.0). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($325.38), and RSI is 39.5.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月18日上涨 0.9%，收于 $352.30，盘中区间 $342.32–356.00，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.56 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$360.7，上行）、10 日（$359.3）、30 日（$399.2）、100 日（$478.6）和 200 日均线（$447.0）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$325.38），RSI 为 39.5。

read.en: No level changed: the $342.32 low stayed above Nov 17's $338.00, and the close stayed under the 10-day. Resistance is $356–360.7 (Nov 18 and 16 highs, 10 and 5-day), then $370.5–372.5 (Nov 13 and 10 closes) and $381. Support is $338–343, then $332.7 (Nov 6 close) and $317–325 (Nov 5 low, SAR). A close above $360.7 would target $370.5–372.5; below $338, $332.7.
